contract.clear: AnimationVM_TickActors and AnimationVM_RunActorPass clear the low byte before payload generation.
contract.produce: Render_BuildActorSpritePayload increments the low byte per 14-byte actor sprite payload.
contract.consume: Render_SubmitActorSprites uses the full word as the buffered-record count.

conclusion: The word counts actor sprite payload records pending VDP submission; its low-byte FFEFEF references are width-preserving accesses.
